dependencies.quack: Requires a clean checkout at 77a750c0d9548d4a6e23c0f64062d61b3ea420ff; package version is insufficient

compile_arguments: Symbolic M/N/K/L; fixed BF16 types/layout/tile/split/mode, intended canonical QKV128

review.mainloop_instructions: Both PTX files contain 8 static m64n128k16.f32.bf16.bf16 WGMMA sites, wait_group 1 and 0, TMA load/store. SASS confirms HGMMA.64x128x16.F32.BF16 and WARPGROUP.DEPBAR. These counts are static, not executed instruction counts.
review.stages_and_layout_differences: IR A/B shared layout has six stages in both modes, S<3,4,3>, K64 tiles. SERIAL has BF16 epilogue S<2,4,3> with four stages; SEPARATE has FP32 epilogue/reducer. Thus finalization is not the only generated-code difference. Both main CTAs are 384 threads. Dynamic shared allocation is present; cuobjdump static SHARED alone is not total launch shared memory.
review.register_spill_shared_resources: cuobjdump each main: REG168 STACK0 LOCAL0 static SHARED1024; reducer REG20 STACK0 LOCAL0 SHARED0. No ld.local/st.local in PTX. Dynamic shared size is not resolved by this resource listing and must not be reported as 1024 total.
review.synchronization_and_initialization: SERIAL PTX has global acquire semaphore loads, bar.sync for the 256 consumer threads, FP32 partial stores/addition, release publication and BF16 conversion. For split2, fixed final split waits for split0; generalized intermediate atomic branch is not a claimed runtime operation. High-level gemm allocates/zeros invocation-local semaphore inside capture. SEPARATE uses disjoint FP32 partials and separate reducer. Sequential replay will be tested; concurrency/liveness beyond canonical resident launch remains unverified.
